description: Absolutely gorgeous FULLY REMODELED single family residence consisting of a total of 4 bedrooms and 3 bathrooms! This house is extremely spacious and beautifully laid out! The total amount of square footage of this property is approximately 1,488 sq ft on an extremely large 4,792 square foot lot! As you enter the home you will notice the gorgeous BRAND NEW laminate wood flooring throughout the entire property along with beautiful tile and vanities in each REMODELED bathrooms! Next you are immediately drawn to the fully BRAND NEW REMODELED KITCHEN! This spacious kitchen also features BRAND NEW beautiful quartz countertops and BRAND NEW shaker cabinets. Continuing to make your way through the home, you’ll discover each bedroom is very generous in size and they all offer an ample amount of closet space. This home has a beautiful PRIMARY SUITE along with large bedrooms and 3 FULLY REMODELED BATHROOMS. The property is also equipped with a LARGE BASEMENT which is very unique for the area! When you reach the backyard you will find a large manicured area with a large amount of space to build an ADU!  This property is conveniently located near schools, shopping, parks and freeways, this one is definitely a MUST SEE! Priced to sell, it’s going to go quickly so schedule a tour today!
